variants.name: DetailPage
variants.summary: A resource detail page rendered through `ConsoleLayout`: the page body sets its own trail with `ConsoleLayout.Breadcrumb` (Applications, the application) ending on its environment as a control crumb, a `Select` with `variant="ghost"` and `size="small"` that searches the environments, tags each with its deployment policy and offers Add Environment at its foot; while compact the header hides the crumbs but keeps the environment `Select` in place of the brand, and below `md` the body repeats the rest of the trail in its own row (back to Applications, the application name); the default slot opens flush on a full-bleed `PageTabs` with the Overview, Deployments and Settings tabs and the outlined Deploy action, which stays in view while the tab content scrolls under it.

variants.name: Notifications
variants.summary: The ListPage rendered through `ConsoleLayout` with a bell in its `actions` slot: the bell carries an unread `Badge` and toggles the layout's tools region (`v-model:tools-open`, titled Notifications, a drawer on a narrow screen), whose `tools` slot lists deploys, invitations and alerts with Mark all as read and Clear all and offers Edit and Redeploy on each deploy; a failed deploy also shows as a flash `Alert` in the `notifications` slot above the page, and an empty list reads You are all caught up through `EmptyState`.

variants.name: AccountSwitch
variants.summary: The ListPage rendered through `ConsoleLayout` with the account switcher in its `sidebar-header` slot, full width in the rail under the wordmark (square `Avatar`, the account name, a sort glyph; tooltip on the right; Ctrl+O or ⌘O), and in its `header-start` slot while compact (avatar and chevron only): a large `Dialog` with search over the organization, group and workspace `Table` tree (expand and collapse, type, ID and client ID), the current account marked, a toast on switch, and Account settings in the footer.

variants.name: AccountSwitchError
variants.summary: The AccountSwitch dialog when the account list fails to load: a danger `Alert`, The account list could not be loaded., with Retry replaces the account `Table` under the search; Retry loads the tree.
